summary: Strengthen the Item Contract and validation checklist so every verified intrinsic/default Item property is owned canonically by the Item, consumed from that canonical source by business/runtime consumers, and may be overridden only through an explicit project/runtime or specialized-renderer override boundary.

impactAnalysis.notes: Governance-only Item architecture clarification. The contract now makes intrinsic/default property ownership, canonical consumer cutover, explicit override boundaries, current-system minimum inventory, definition minimum mapping, and hard-fail completion criteria mandatory. No runtime implementation, BOM quantity, renderer implementation, persistence schema, or audit finding remediation is changed in this commit.

e2e.reason: This change updates Item governance contracts only; no browser/runtime behavior is modified. Full CI remains required by repository policy.

risk.notes: Documentation/governance change only. It intentionally tightens future Item completion criteria without modifying current runtime code.

migration.notes: No persisted data migration is required. Previously completed Items may require later re-validation against the strengthened checklist.

rollback: Restore the previous Item Contract and checklist wording. No runtime or persisted-data rollback is required.
